✅ Last 5 Games card shows accuracy, W/L/D, blunder rate correctly
✅ Overall card shows same metrics for all games
✅ Weakness control shows patterns with direction (improving/worsening/stable)
✅ Weakest phase only flagged if score < 75% (correct behavior - no weakest shown when all >= 75%)
✅ Review Impact shows before/after blunder rate and accuracy with percentage change

✅ Game Timeline shows horizontal bars with opponent name, accuracy %, W/L/D result
✅ Timeline games are clickable and navigate to /game/{gameId}
✅ Weakness cards are clickable and navigate to /training?focus={pattern}
✅ Empty state handled correctly (has_data: false when no games)
